_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% base rate for ±2+ point moves over 7 days confirms this is a coil where HOLD with conviction is the skilled call — the August analog and DXY weakness suggest an eventual UP leg into Disbelief, but ETF flow collapse and elevated VIX mean the breaker has not yet emerged.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial agreement — both see a post-bottom recovery analog pointing toward Disbelief, but the analyst insists on waiting for confirmation (HOLD) while the narrative frames the relief rally as already underway; the analyst's higher trust weight (7.67 vs. 6.00) and self-awareness of his direction-forcing failure mode tip the consensus toward patience.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30, funding stays below 60, and BTC 30-day momentum pushes above 60 — this confirms the upward leg into Hope
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows remain near 0, VIX spikes above 70, and BTC 30-day momentum rolls below 45 — this invalidates the recovery thesis and suggests a drop to Anxiety
